layout.emptyGroup: No configurable keys in this group
layout.discardConfirmBody: The current tab has unsaved changes. Switching tabs will discard them.

userMemory.title: Global long-term memory
userMemory.scopeHint: User preferences/facts/feedback shared across all sessions
userMemory.empty: No global memory yet. Click the button above to create one.

defaultModels.empty: No provider available, configure in Providers & Models first

consolidation.description: This consolidation merges and reorganizes skills and memory: it periodically merges duplicate/conflicting content and archives or disables over-limit historical entries (never physically deleted).
consolidation.restartNotice: Changes to the toggle/time/model require an app restart to take effect (no hot reload).

error.inProgress: A consolidation task is already running, please try again later.

webFetch.jinaApiKeyDesc: Requests use Bearer auth when configured (anonymous access also available)

observability.deleteBody: Delete {{name}}? This cannot be undone; related trace data will not be deleted.
observability.changeNotice: Changes take effect on next launch or new session.

basic.title: Basic information
basic.hint: Instance name and backend connection info

auth.title: Authentication keys
auth.hint: Langfuse public/private keys; private key stays local, never uploaded

dualRecord.label: Dual recording
dualRecord.tooltip: When enabled, each LLM call logs two generations: logical (business view) + physical (wire body sent to LLM). Physical carries no usage and does not affect token/cost stats. Default off = only logical LLM requests are logged. Changes take effect on restart or new session.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Dark / light theme; takes effect after save

max_retry_times.label: Max Retry Attempts
max_retry_times.desc: Max retry attempts on LLM request failure

enabled.label: Enable Consolidation
enabled.desc: When enabled, runs a daily skill/memory consolidation task; when disabled, the task does not exist — no scheduling, no LLM calls

dailyTime.label: Daily Consolidation Time
dailyTime.desc: Time of day the consolidation task triggers (local timezone)

modelId.label: Consolidation Model
modelId.desc: Model used by the consolidation task; if unconfigured, it silently skips without error

maxSkillInject.label: Skill Injection Limit
maxSkillInject.desc: Max number of skills injected per session (default 50)

maxMemoryInject.label: Memory Injection Limit
maxMemoryInject.desc: Max number of memories injected per session (default 50)

enableLlmRequestLog.label: Log LLM Request
enableLlmRequestLog.desc: Log outbound LLM calls to logs/llm.log

enableToolResultLog.label: Log Tool Result
enableToolResultLog.desc: Log tool call results to logs/tool.log

enableAppApiLog.label: Log App API
enableAppApiLog.desc: Log inbound HTTP requests to logs/api.log

enableEventLog.label: Log Event
enableEventLog.desc: Log event hub events to logs/event.log

enableErrorLog.label: Log Errors
enableErrorLog.desc: Log system errors (agent/LLM/unhandled exceptions) to logs/error.log

enableAgentLog.label: Log Agent Diagnostics
enableAgentLog.desc: Log agent loop enter/exit, session state changes, inbox enqueue/drain to logs/agent.log (ids/counts/status only, no message content)

enablePerformanceLog.label: Log Performance
enablePerformanceLog.desc: Log slow queries (persistence queries over 200ms) to logs/performance.log (entity/duration/row count, for locating bottlenecks)
